system.description:
Tianqi Inheritance: a business. Very Rare, Air. No item slots.

Through political questions (or those of your family), you have been granted the title of Boriand, or mayor, of a small town by your local noble.

Township’s Rule (Passive, Ceremony): You have been granted the Boriandship of a small town. Work with your GM to define which Noble to whom you owe allegiance, and the town for which you are mayor. Every long rest, if you have 0 Influence in your town, gain 1 influence you can expend to support your town. If your Noble requires anything of you, you will also be expected to support them.

Rulebook p.64.
